Subject: Request: pilot net60 + rolling credit buffer (WaveTech)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the demo last week. WaveTech is keen to kick off a two-month pilot (expected usage ~750k tokens/week) starting mid-November. Procurement asked me to confirm commercial asks before I route the PO:

- Net60 payment terms for the pilot period (we can move to Net45 after 90 days of steady usage)
- A rolling credit buffer of €75k to cover spikes; WaveTech will top up via PO if breached
- Invoicing to our EU entity (WaveTech B.V.) — we have VAT-forwarding needs and need your VAT registration evidence for our AP team

I've attached a proforma and our VAT certificate. Can Redwood confirm whether Net60 + rolling buffer is workable and outline any compliance evidence you need?

Appreciate a short confirmation and any suggested invoice cadence (monthly vs. biweekly).

Best,
Elena
Finance/Operations
WaveTech

Subject: Re: Request: pilot net60 + rolling credit buffer (WaveTech)

Hi Elena —

Thanks — and great to hear the pilot is moving forward. High-level response: we can accommodate Net60 for a limited pilot window, but to protect against under-collateralized spikes we propose a triggered-credit framework rather than a fixed large upfront buffer. Key points:

- Net terms: Net60 for pilot (60 days from invoice), with an automatic review at 90 days to move to Net45 if usage is steady.
- Triggered credit buffer: start with a €25k rolling buffer. When forecasted 7-day spend exceeds 70% of the buffer, an automated alert triggers a top-up PO request. If WaveTech does not top up within 7 days, invoices for incremental usage will be placed on a shorter Net30 cadence until top-up is received.
- VAT & invoicing: Redwood can invoice WaveTech B.V. — we will need WaveTech's VAT number, confirmation of AP remittance entity, and a copy of your VAT certificate (you attached — thanks). Our EU billing team will issue invoices with EU VAT handling; we also provide a monthly VAT reconciliation report.

I'll loop in Finance (Laura) and Billing (Marcus) to outline operational steps and what evidence we need to generate the first invoice.

Are you open to monthly invoices with mid-month interim statements? That keeps admin light while preserving control over exposure.

Regards,
Sofia
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

---
Sofia Ivanova

Subject: RE: Request: pilot net60 + rolling credit buffer (WaveTech)

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO template. Confirming final ops details so our billing team can issue the first invoice on Nov 1:

1) Net terms: Net60 for the two-month pilot (60 days from invoice date). We will automatically review and attempt to move to Net45 at the 90-day mark based on usage stability.
2) Rolling buffer: €30,000 agreed. Trigger at 70% (automated email and billing portal notification). If top-up not received within 7 days, incremental usage will roll to Net30 until top-up is received.
3) Invoice cadence: monthly invoices on the 1st. Mid-month statement on the 15th showing run-rate and trigger warnings.
4) VAT & billing entity: we'll invoice WaveTech B.V. Please send exact registered entity name and VAT ID (format: NL123456789B01). Laura: billing team will require the VAT cert in PDF and the PO number.
4b) Escrow / dispute handling: Redwood will not require a 3rd-party escrow for pilot; instead we'll hold disputed amounts in a pending balance within our billing system for up to 30 days while both parties resolve.

Next steps:
- Elena: send VAT ID and PO number (by COB Monday).
- Laura: prep invoice template and send draft to accounting@wavetech.ai (cc Sofia, Marcus).
- Priyom: document the temporary pending-balance process for legal sign-off (if needed).

We'll mark the deal WT-2026-314 as "pilot-approved" and await PO to bill the first month.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Marcus Lin
